new_defects.title: The proof-4 `tsc --noEmit` reopen command is ambiguous: a bare `tsc` on this host is not the project's TypeScript
new_defects.evidence: New this pass. In the frozen-head copy, bare `tsc --noEmit` resolved to ~/Library/pnpm/tsc = TypeScript 5.9.3 and exited 2 with `tsconfig.json(14,27): error TS5103: Invalid value for '--ignoreDeprecations'`, because the repo sets `"ignoreDeprecations": "6.0"`, which only TypeScript 6.x accepts. The repo pins typescript 6.0.3 in node_modules/.bin, and `bun run` prepends node_modules/.bin to PATH, which is why build:raw's own internal `tsc --noEmit` passed and why the chain continued. With the project tsc (`PATH=<repo>/node_modules/.bin:$PATH tsc --noEmit`, `Version 6.0.3`) the command exits 0 in the frozen-head copy and in the checkout (C04). Not a slice defect - tsconfig is untouched by this slice - but the DONE line `tsc --noEmit is clean` should name the project-resolved tsc (or `bun run`/`pnpm exec tsc`) beside CHQA-D3's build line. Non-blocking.
